question: The Champaran Satyagraha took place in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1917.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Champaran Satyagraha** took place in **1917** in the **Champaran district of Bihar.**
 
• It was led by Mahatma Gandhi and was his first successful Satyagraha</strong&
